lines: Good morning, Eliya! The cherry blossoms by the canal are in full bloom.
Hello Eliya! Look at how fresh the morning dew is.
Eliya! My hands feel so bare… could you make me Cherry Blossom French with a little ribbon bow?
Thank you, Eliya! These will brighten my whole day at the flower cart.
Eliya, this is stunning! Like real cherry petals captured on my fingertips. Absolutely wonderful!
Better late than never! They still look lovely, thank you Eliya.
Eliya. Clay on the wheel, tea in the mug. Good day for creating.
Just trimming a new vase. How are the brushes today?
I need a set that can handle clay but still look refined. How about Rose Quartz French?
Nice work. Solid lines, smooth finish.
Now that is artisan craft. The glaze and bevel are impeccable. Outstanding work, Eliya.
Took your time, didn't you? At least the finish didn't crack.
Eliya!! Look at this light today, perfect for Life4Cuts!
Heeey Eliya! Did you bring new nail art today? I need photos!
Eliya!! Could you do Apricot Pearl? The pearlescent sheen will look SO cute in the photobooth flash!
Cute! Going straight into the photo strip album!
KYAAA!! This is literally perfection!! Look at that shine! We HAVE to do a photoshoot right now!
Aww, almost missed the golden hour! But still so so cute!
안녕하세요, Eliya. Fresh matcha latte is ready whenever you need a break.
The morning rush is calm today. Care for some steamed tea?
A quiet matcha glaze set would soothe the eyes while pouring espresso. What do you say?
고마워요, Eliya. Very soothing and subtle.
대단해요! The color gradient is poetic. It captures the spirit of our market café beautifully.
The latte got cold, but the nails are still warm and sweet.
Welcome to the market! Looking for ribbons, vials, or a good trade today?
Good to see you Eliya! Fresh goods just arrived at the stall.
I've got a busy market day ahead. Can you craft me an Apricot Pearl set? I'll trade you some ribbon for it!
A deal is a deal! Looks very practical and pretty.
Top quality! You really know how to deliver premium atelier craftsmanship. Worth every single coin!
Time is money in the market, Eliya! But fine, I can't stay mad with nails this pretty.
Dag lieverd! Come sit by the greenhouse. The tulips are listening to the breeze.
Hello little Eliya! Take your time, there is no hurry in the meadow.
My old gardening hands would love some gentle blossom petals, dear. Could you paint me some?
Dank je wel, Eliya. My hands feel like young tulip stems again.
Prachtig! Truly magnificent, my dear. The flowers in the meadow will be envious!
No rush at all, child. Flowers take time to bloom too.
Eliya!! Look at this bug I found in the tulips!
Eliya Eliya! Did you bring sparkly things from the studio?
Can I have sparkly apricot pearl nails with cute polka dots please please please?!
Yaaaay!! Look how shiny they are! Thank you Eliya!
WOOOOOW!! Three whole stars!! I'm gonna show everybody at school!
I waited so long! But yay, sparkly nails are here!
Ah, the water ripples softly tonight... Hello, quiet artisan.
The harbour moon is high, Eliya. A serene night for gentle inspiration.
The moonlight reflecting on the waves inspires me... Could you craft Moonlight Cat-Eye for my evening salon?
A quiet shimmer for the quiet night. Thank you, Eliya.
Sublime. The velvet magnetic beam dances like silver ripples across the canal at midnight. Extraordinary.
The night is still young, Eliya. Thank you for making the journey.
